title: Why Ram Trucks Are Surging in 2026 (And the Catch Nobody Mentions)
description:
One pickup truck jumped seventy-three percent in a single quarter, while the best-selling truck in America was almost flat. And the reason is not a new design, or a price cut. It is an engine that the company had dropped, and a warranty that was supposed to end. Ram is surging in twenty twenty-six, and here is the real story, with the numbers, and the catch that nobody mentions.

Sources:
Every number in this video comes from a published source, and the sources are listed in the description. We used MoparInsiders for the Stellantis figures, Autoblog for the explanations, Pickup Truck Talk for the nine-month table, and the J.D. Power and iSeeCars studies for the quality, resale and longevity numbers. Where we could not confirm something, we say so.
